description:
Storyhouse are proud to present this two bedroom apartment in Barnoaks . This apartment comes fully furnished and comprises of an open plan living and kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a utility room. Barnoaks is situated very close to the Luas red line and within walking distance to Citywest Business Campus and Citywest Shopping Centre all whilst surrounded by stunning views of the Dublin mountains. With easy access to Dublin City Centre via excellent transport links such as the Luas, various bus routes and just 10 minutes from the M50, Barnoaks is a great choice and offers many local amenities such as creches, schools, supermarkets and Citywest Shopping Centre, which is adjacent to the development, houses a large Dunnes Stores alongside many other retailers.

*DISCLAIMER: Photos are for illustrative purposes only and the layout may differ depending on type. Due to an exceedingly high volume of interest we are unable to respond to all enquiries. We wish you all the very best of luck with your search
